result.instructions: Tools for Cogmento, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which deals are open in my Cogmento pipeline and what are they worth?"; "Find the contact Eric Smith and show their related tasks and cases."; "Create a task 'Send proposal' due 2026-11-03.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Cogmento data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run cogmento_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run cogmento_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run cogmento_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. cogmento_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: cogmento_get_current_user
tools.title: Get current user
tools.description: The Cogmento user this API token belongs to: id, name, email, timezone and account id. GET /auth/user/.

tools.name: cogmento_get_account
tools.title: Get account
tools.description: The Cogmento account: name, country, settings, billing plan, trial days left and number of users. GET /account/.

tools.name: cogmento_get_templates
tools.title: Get field templates
tools.description: The field definitions (names, labels, types, options) of the account's templates for each record type: contacts, companies, deals, cases, tasks. Use it to learn the custom field names for filters, creates and field updates. GET /templates/.

tools.name: cogmento_list_contacts
tools.title: List contacts
tools.description: List or search contacts (name, email and phone channels, company). Filter on any field, e.g. first_name contains 'Eric'. GET /contacts/.

filters.description: Conditions, all of which must match (AND). Dates are yyyy-mm-dd.

field.description: Field name, e.g. first_name, title, status.

operator.description: eq, gt, gte, lt, lte or contains.

sort.description: Field to sort by, e.g. created_at; prefix with - for descending, e.g. -last_modified.

start.description: Row offset to start from (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_start.

tools.name: cogmento_get_contact
tools.title: Get contact
tools.description: One full contact record, including its related tasks, cases, calls, events and documents. GET /contacts/{id}/.

tools.name: cogmento_create_contact
tools.title: Create contact
tools.description: WRITE: create a contact. Needs first and last name; email and phone are optional. POST /contacts/.

email.description: Email address; stored as an Email channel.

phone.description: Phone number, ideally in international format (+14155550100).

tags.description: Tags to put on the record.

tools.name: cogmento_update_record_field
tools.title: Update one field of a record
tools.description: WRITE: change a single field of a contact, company, deal, task or case, e.g. a deal's status or a contact's first_name. Custom field names come from cogmento_get_templates. System fields (id, acl, private, timestamps) are refused. PATCH /<type>/{id}/.

record_type.description: contact, company, deal, task or case.

field_name.description: Field to set, e.g. first_name, title, status, amount, due_date.

value.description: The new value (type must match the field; dates yyyy-mm-dd; null clears a field).

annotations.title: Update one field of a record
